question.text: Which one of the following statements is not correct?

options.text: The bond angle in methanol is 1 0 8 . 9 o
Alcohols are weaker acids than water
Carbon-oxygen bond length in methanol, CH<sub>3</sub>OH is shorter than that of C - O bond length in phenol.

Acid strength of alcohols decreases in the following order <math> <mrow> <mtext>RCH</mtext> <msub> <mspace></mspace> <mn>2</mn> </msub> <mtext>OH</mtext> <mo>></mo> <mtext>R</mtext> <msub> <mspace></mspace> <mtext>2</mtext> </msub> <mtext>CHOH</mtext> <mo>></mo> <msub> <mtext>R</mtext> <mtext>3</mtext> </msub> <mtext>COH</mtext> </mrow> </math> ​

solution.text: Carbon-oxygen bond length in methanol, CH3OH is longer than that of C - O bond length in phenol. This is due to the partial double bond character in C-O bond of Phenol due to resonance.
